speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Bacterial Pneumonia.

The patient is a 30-year-old male with a one-week history of left chest pain, purulent sputum, and shortness of breath, following an untreated influenza infection. Given the progression of symptoms and purulent nature of the sputum, I am requesting a Chest_X-Ray to confirm the presence of lung consolidation and rule out complications.
